# Model the legitimate durable BeginAttempt-before-backend.Start recovery prefix.
# The actual daemon observes the unowned attempt as UNKNOWN; no native workload
# ever started, no UNKNOWN row is seeded, and no abrupt stop/child death is claimed.
skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json hold
starting-prefix task.json $DOMAIN unknown JOB
server start
await-job-state $JOB unknown
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout '"reason": *"unknown"'
! stdout 'private-task-value|SKYGO_RETENTION_WORKDIR|SKYGO_RETENTION_WORKLOAD'
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
stdout 'JOB_STATE_UNKNOWN'
event-count 0
! exists ready
server stop
! stderr .
